{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_vrtx_011CgjQSvQLA1bfHEiqznuBj","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I fixed it so coins that fall into water now sink slowly and drift instead of dropping to the floor and stopping. The project builds cleanly, but I haven't run the game to watch the new behaviour in the chasm from the recording.\n\nThe change is in `HeavyCoin::update` (`src/object/coin.cpp`), the only file I touched. Each frame the coin checks whether it overlaps water tiles, the same way the snowball, bullet and crusher code already does. While it's in water:\n- **Gravity** drops to 20% of normal, and the sinking speed is capped at 80 px/s, so a coin that hits the water fast slows down right away.\n- **Sideways movement** fades out gradually, which gives the drift.\n- **Overall movement** is halved, matching how bullets behave in water.\n\nOut of water, gravity goes back to normal.\n\nCoins in water now always reach the floor slowly enough that they no longer bounce off it. They come to rest there after the slow sink, which is what the issue asked for. The 20%, 80 px/s and drift-fade values are my own picks and easy to adjust if the motion feels off in play."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":7547,"cache_read_input_tokens":29491,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":7547,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3},"input_transformations":[],"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"36b06661-7fa5-440c-a583-48356e6e8eb8","uuid":"3e0821cc-5ca2-4b99-8843-8458872cf580","timestamp":"2026-11-05T07:42:22.258Z","request_id":"req_vrtx_011CgjQSvNMBQmk8jEiikuSG"}
